notes: Warn-only on PR/push; strict only after complete multi-run baselines are stable.
Initial hardening tracks JS-heavy signals first because exported HTML aliases inflate total/html counts.
Tune limits downward as optimizations land to enforce gradual improvement.
Lighthouse limits currently apply to mobile-375x812 under methods.simulate (primary user device class).
Budget suggestions generated from 10 complete simulate/mobile-375x812 runs on 2026-05-12.
Bundle maxGzipJsBytes keeps the historical p95-based ceiling; raw JS ceilings were tightened again after the Auth/Workspace web export changed the stable entry size in June 2026.
The / route had one cold-run LCP outlier at 22378ms; the 24616ms suggestion was not adopted because warm runs cluster near 903ms.
jsExecutionMs uses Lighthouse bootup-time when available and is persisted into history for future method-aware comparisons.
Plan target: lcpMs <= 3000 for /, 3200 for /shopping, 3400 for /recipe/1 (see Phase 3 acceptance criteria).

2026-09-27 rebaseline (package 5b, Expo SDK 57): derived with perf:budget:suggest from 10 sequential CI warn runs 36330938173..36333787988 (simulate, mobile-375x812, audit server gzips like production, discarded Lighthouse warm-up run).

Bundle limits are the measured SDK-57 export plus ~3% (jsBytes 5744683, gzipJsBytes p95 1191752, largest 4807957). The suggester's p95*1.1 (6319151 / 1310927 / 5288753) was not adopted: bundle sizes are deterministic per commit, so 10% would hide ~575 KB of growth.
lcpMs follows the suggester (p95*1.1): simulated LCP is shell-bound at 902-910 ms with <1% spread. cls stays at 0.02 because the suggested 0 would fail on any sub-pixel shift.

jsExecutionMs is measured bootup-time on shared CI runners, not simulated, and spread 1209-2954 ms across identical code on all three routes. All routes use the worst-route suggestion (3250 = /recipe/1 p95 2954 * 1.1).

Tighten again once the entry chunk shrinks: lucide-react-native used to bundle all 1721 icons (~1.2 MB raw / ~133 KB gzip) for 73 used icons; jsQR lazy-load (PR #66) moved ~128 KB raw out of the entry chunk.

2026-09-29 rebaseline (package 6, lucide tree shaking): the entry chunk dropped from 4807423 to 2015231 bytes raw (gzip 859065 -> 504241) after components/icons.tsx plus EXPO_UNSTABLE_METRO_OPTIMIZE_GRAPH/EXPO_UNSTABLE_TREE_SHAKING in scripts/mobile/expo-export-web.mjs. Measured with npm run build:mobile on this commit: jsBytes 3075351, gzipJsBytes 830637, largestJsAssetBytes 2015231, cssBytes 22979, files 34.

The 2026-09-29 bundle limits are the values agreed in the cleanup plan. They carry more headroom than the ~3 % convention implies (largestJsAssetBytes 4100000 vs 2015231 measured), because the tree shaking saved ~2.8 MB raw instead of the assumed ~0.8 MB; a follow-up rebaseline to ~+3 % of the measured export is possible but deliberately left to the CI measurement series.
